items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: you’d have like Frank Wess, Frank Foster, you’d have like Joe Newman, Snooky Young, so no fools in that band.

ctx.x: Just before we move on here, can you — any commercials that might ring a bell with us? I mean I know you’ve done many.

Yeah but I haven’t done them in well over 20, well 25 years. But I did do stuff with the original Fifth Dimension for Chevrolet or Jello or something. Did some stuff with Ella Fitzgerald for McDonald’s was it? She did a whole thing but I did like a Basie kind of Ella thing. And then we did some Basie Joe Williams type things except we couldn’t get Joe so we used Grady Tate, who is a hell of a singer. And I did — oh man I did a bunch of stuff for Michelob beer for Vic Damone was the singer on some of those. And in…
Sometimes they still, they have this retro channel or something and they show some of the older commercials.
